name: Ikegami Tatsuhiko
source:
Tatsuhiko decides to return to his hometown in search of the source of a mysterious stone that came into his possession. One of the villagers, [url=/c106116]Yuuka[/url], tells Tatsuhiko an old tale about a Yuki-Onna's daughter which was trapped somewhere in the area. Whilst only half-believing that story, he starts exploring and one night he comes across a girl named [url=/c106115]Miyuki[/url], who is a Yuki-Onna's daughter.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010625112432fw_/http://www.din.or.jp/~syscom/ange/new/eternity/index.html]official website[/url].]
